notes.title: Update Build 1.0.2.3
notes.content:
Update Build 1.0.2.3

Replacement of various assets with higher quality versions and enhanced textures.

Fixes and improvements to several UI widgets.

General performance optimizations.

New interface: more modern, intuitive, and responsive.

Enemy system update: code optimization and fixes to improve game performance.

New lighting bake, delivering more realistic and immersive lighting.

Fixes to the music track system, with new songs added to enhance the overall atmosphere.

Improved damage and combat system for Creepy enemies.

Minor improvements to the infected combat system.

Added anisotropic filtering (4x, 8x, and 16x) to enhance visual quality.

Adjustments to the player character mesh to prevent deformation during fast movements, along with the addition of subtle facial expressions during gameplay.

New resource balancing, allowing players to unlock all special weapons within a single playthrough.

Various minor tweaks and general improvements.

Note:
The game is constantly evolving. We are working hard to implement as many community suggestions as possible. In the upcoming patches, we will introduce major structural updates, always taking great care not to compromise player progress or saved games.

Thank you for your understanding and support!
Sincerely,
Jardel Antunes
CEO - BoxGames Productions

notes.title: Build Notes 1.0.2.2
notes.content:
[b]Build Notes 1.0.2.2[/b]
Updates
[b]Sound Enhancements:[/b]
New sounds for reloading, zombie footsteps, and ambient effects for greater immersion.
[b]Improved Particle Effects:[/b]
Enhanced dismemberment and headshot effects with better quality.
[b]Animation Adjustments:[/b]
Minor fixes to player and enemy animations.
Tweaks to cinematics for smoother transitions.
[b]Material Optimization:[/b]
Some materials have been refined to improve visual quality and performance.
[b]Game Design Adjustments:[/b]
Removed some underused features that didn’t enhance the player experience, such as the chocolate bar and water, which restored stamina.
Reworked some environments to make them more visually appealing, adding more blood and horror elements.
[b]UI/UX Improvements:[/b]
Adjusted the interface to ensure gamepad players don’t have to switch to a keyboard in certain situations. We apologize for the oversight!
[b]Bug Fixes:[/b]
Fixed gamepad issues—now the game is fully functional on all controllers (we recommend an Xbox controller).
Fixed invisible wall glitches.
Resolved crashes on PCs with low video memory.
Optimized some outdated logic to improve performance.
We are committed to delivering the best possible quality in our game! Thank you to everyone who provided feedback. Our team is small (just two people), so we can’t always reply to everyone, but we are doing our best to improve the game with every update.

Thank you for your support!

Best regards,
Jardel Antunes
Game Developer & Co-Founder of BoxGames Productions

notes.title: Deadly Contagion Version 1.0.1.8 - Patch Notes
notes.content:
[b]Version 1.0.1.8 - Patch Notes[/b]

New Features:
* Added Physical Objects: New interactive elements that enhance the realism of the environment.
Added Auto Aim Support: Players using controllers now have auto aim assistance to make combat smoother.
* New Traps: Additional traps have been added to increase challenge and variety.
* New Weapons: Three new weapons are now available for purchase at the workbench, expanding your arsenal.
* Balancing Adjustments:
Weapon Damage Balancing: Adjustments made to better balance the firepower of the weapons.
Enemy Health Balancing: Enemy health has been reviewed to ensure a more consistent difficulty across different types of enemies.
* Fixes and Optimizations:
Water Physics Fix: Corrected the water behavior, which now responds properly to physical interactions.
Music Track Fix (Musitrack): Fixed an issue where certain music tracks continued playing even when the volume was turned down.
Code Cleanup: Optimized the code to improve overall game performance.
*  Minor Bug Fixes: Various small bugs have been addressed, ensuring a smoother gameplay experience.
Improvements:
*  Code for Other Platforms: Code has been optimized and prepared for releases on other platforms, including Epic Games Store and Microsoft Store.
*  Added Sound Effects: New sound effects have been added for the recently introduced weapons.
*  Workbench Weapon Adjustments: Improved weapon arrangement on the workbench for easier access and purchasing.
*  Cinematics Polishing: Focus adjustments in the intro cinematic for increased immersion.
*  Visual Widget Improvements: Polished the graphical interfaces and enhanced visual clarity for a more refined user experience.
*  Texture Updates: Replaced some textures with higher quality versions to provide a more visually pleasing experience.

ATT: Jardel Antunes
GameDeveloper and CEO BoxGames Productions

notes.title: Patch Update Version V: 1.0.0.2
notes.content:
[b]Build Notes Version V: 1.0.0.2[/b]

Collider Fixes / Bugs:

Addressed collision issues causing interaction problems with the environment.
Resolved various bugs reported by the community affecting gameplay.
Map Fixes / Bugs (Blue / Pink Doors):

Fixed some cinematic cameras losing focus.
Blue and pink doors now function correctly, eliminating locking or accessibility issues.
Map-related problems have been resolved, ensuring a smoother, uninterrupted gaming experience.
Infected Grab Fixes / Player Disarmament:

Adjusted infected grab mechanics for consistent functionality without flaws.
Player disarmament issues have been rectified to enhance combat fluidity and player experience.
Stamina Adjustment:

Tweaked player stamina mechanics to achieve a better balance between movement speed and endurance during in-game physical activities.
Aim Adjustment (Gamepad Sensitivity):

Gamepad sensitivity has been fine-tuned to ensure a more precise and responsive aiming experience, enhancing overall gameplay satisfaction for players using this control device.
These changes summarize the key enhancements and bug fixes implemented in this game version.

[b]Please note: The game is developed by a single person, and we are preparing a patch for release on February 10th to address some additional bugs. We will also be hiring additional developers to further improve the game![/b]
